title: Who is telling the story? A systematic review of authorship for infectious disease research conducted in Africa, 1980-2016
notes: MATCHES (49.8%). Abstract (PDF p.1), Results p.3: of 1182 articles, 1109 (93.2%) had at least one Africa-based author, 552 (49.8%) an African first author, 41.3% (n=458) an African last author.
